Anthropic raises $124 million Series A

https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-raises-124-million-to-build-more-reliable-general-ai-systems

Series A led by Jaan Tallinn with participation from Dustin Moskovitz. Self-published by the lab, not by any evaluator; used as the primary record that the principals of SFF (Tallinn) and Coefficient Giving (Moskovitz) are Anthropic investors. Shared record: identical in the palisade, cais, rand and hal files; ledger rows R01 and R02 already cite it.

Signals citing this source

  • Center for AI Safety, F (against): SFF recommended $289,000 to CAIS in 2025 (about $1.1M cumulative per 80,000 Hours); SFF's funder Jaan Tallinn led Anthropic's Series A.
  • Holistic Agent Leaderboard (Princeton), F (against): HAL is funded by Coefficient Giving, whose principal is an Anthropic investor, and receives API credits from OpenAI and Google to evaluate their models.
  • Palisade Research, F (against): SFF recommended $1,133,000 to Palisade in 2025 (plus a $928,000 matching pledge); SFF's funder Jaan Tallinn led Anthropic's Series A.
  • RAND, F (against): Large share of AI work funded by Coefficient Giving.
  • RAND, F (against): SFF recommended $1,022,000 to RAND's Technology and Security Policy Center in 2025; SFF's funder Jaan Tallinn led Anthropic's Series A.
